origin.description: Call stri_sprintf as a binary operator.

arguments.name: e2
arguments.text: One atomic vector, or a list of atomic vectors.

origin.details: A vector that is not a list is passed as one argument. Missing values stay missing. na_string is NA, inf_string is Inf, and nan_string is NaN.

translation.description: Call stri_sprintf as a binary operator.

arguments.name: e1
arguments.text: A format string, or a list of them.

arguments.name: e2
arguments.text: One vector, or a tuple of vectors. A nested list is also a list of arguments.

translation.details: A tuple, or a list that contains lists, is the argument list. Any other value is one vector. This calls stri_sprintf with na_string NA.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing element is NA.
